purpose: Map public attack, smart-contract, DeFi incident, and chaos-engineering taxonomies onto ZenoDEX-specific disaster-search axes. This is a search-expansion artifact, not a proof that the public taxonomies are complete.

coverage_contract.promotion_rule: A mapped public family becomes a stronger assurance claim only after the referenced ZenoDEX axis has replayable evidence, proof evidence, fuzz evidence, or an explicit out-of-scope decision.

public_sources.name: OWASP Smart Contract Security
public_sources.role: Smart-contract verification, weakness, and testing taxonomy.

public_sources.name: OWASP Smart Contract Top 10
public_sources.role: High-level Web3 vulnerability family seed catalog.

public_sources.name: Smart Contract Weakness Classification Registry
public_sources.role: Legacy smart-contract weakness names; not treated as complete because the registry is no longer actively maintained.

public_sources.name: De.Fi Rekt Database
public_sources.role: Incident-derived DeFi category and exploit-shape seeds.

public_sources.name: Principles of Chaos Engineering
public_sources.role: Operational perturbation and steady-state disruption seeds.

source_families: CAPEC: race condition and time-of-check/time-of-use style attack patterns
OWASP SCSVS-BRIDGE: blockchain data and state management
Chaos: clock skew, delayed events, recovery ordering
entries.what_if: Epoch, clock, lifecycle, or fairness views disagree and an old or future state is treated as current.

source_families: OWASP SC01/SC04 style access-control and authorization failures
OWASP SCSVS-AUTH: access control and authentication
SWC legacy: authorization, signature replay, role mismanagement
entries.what_if: A valid-looking action is authorized under the wrong signer, role, capability, session, nonce, or policy identity.

source_families: OWASP SC02/SC04: business logic and flash-loan-facilitated attacks
OWASP SCWE: transaction order dependence and extractable value from predictable ordering
De.Fi Rekt: DEX and flash-loan incident categories
entries.what_if: Two semantically neighboring candidate sets, orderings, or repaired routes select different winners or admit extractive ordering.

source_families: CAPEC: data structure manipulation and input manipulation
OWASP SC05: lack of input validation
OWASP SCWE: ABI encoding, calldata length, type conversion, bitwise, and right-to-left override failures
entries.what_if: A byte width, schema field, parser envelope, or symbolic rewrite changes meaning while preserving a valid-looking shape.

source_families: OWASP SC10: denial of service
OWASP SCSVS-BLOCK and SCSVS-DEFI: DoS, gas usage, loop efficiency
Chaos: traffic spike and downstream overload
entries.what_if: A caller or dependency chooses bounds that turn advisory, quote, proof, subprocess, or optimization work into a CPU/memory availability failure.

source_families: CAPEC: supply-chain, protocol, and communication attack patterns
OWASP SCSVS-COMM: secure interactions and communications
Chaos: malformed response, dependency outage, network severance
entries.what_if: A remote endpoint, external verifier, subprocess, imported source, or transport boundary returns stale, malformed, excessive, or mismatched data.

source_families: CAPEC: replay and transaction manipulation attack patterns
OWASP SCWE: nonce handling and replay vulnerabilities
Chaos: restart, persistence loss, partial failure
entries.what_if: A partially-applied, replayed, recovered, or persisted artifact is accepted as fresh and complete.

source_families: OWASP SC07/SC09: arithmetic, rounding, precision, overflow, underflow
OWASP SCSVS-ORACLE: arithmetic and logic security
SWC legacy: integer overflow, unsafe downcasting, rounding direction
entries.what_if: Integer runtime arithmetic, rounding envelopes, BVA artifacts, or curve-family math disagree with a proof or economic invariant.

source_families: OWASP SC03: price oracle manipulation
OWASP SCSVS-BRIDGE: blockchain data and state management
De.Fi Rekt: DEX, lending, stablecoin, and oracle-dependent incidents
entries.what_if: Oracle freshness, provenance, benefit accounting, or market-data proof lanes split and a stale price becomes authoritative.

source_families: CAPEC: trust boundary and data integrity attack patterns
OWASP SCSVS-CRYPTO and SCSVS-COMM: signature, hash, and communication integrity
De.Fi Rekt: bridge and infrastructure categories
entries.what_if: A confidential request, receipt, verifier, or nonce root is bound to a neighboring private state.

source_families: CAPEC: supply-chain and trusted artifact substitution
OWASP SCSVS-CODE: code management and dependency controls
Chaos: tooling drift and artifact replay
entries.what_if: A proof, receipt, registry, toolchain, release matrix, or generated artifact remains valid after its source root changes.

source_families: OWASP SC02: business logic vulnerabilities
OWASP SCSVS-GOV: business logic and economic security
CAPEC: transaction and data integrity patterns
entries.what_if: A settlement certificate, recompute proof, witness lifecycle, or native witness adapter accepts a value not bound to the current execution state.

source_families: OWASP SC02: business logic vulnerabilities
OWASP SC07: arithmetic and precision failures
De.Fi Rekt: DEX and AMM incident categories
entries.what_if: A market namespace, curve tag, adapter, or reference model changes while a neighboring state is treated as equivalent.

source_families: OWASP SCSVS-GOV: business logic and economic security
De.Fi Rekt: token, stablecoin, yield aggregator, and incentive incidents
CAPEC: abuse of reward and business logic conditions
entries.what_if: A reward, rebate, proof-mining, FIRE, tokenomics, or repair-economics path spends more than its verified budget or binds to a stale package.

source_families: CAPEC: manipulation of trusted decision inputs
OWASP SCSVS-AUTH and SCSVS-GOV: authority and business logic boundaries
Chaos: stale facts and policy artifact drift
entries.what_if: A non-authoritative AI/KRR/advisory output is mistaken for live authority, or a fact/policy/ranking artifact drifts after signing.

source_families: De.Fi Rekt: stablecoin and borrowing/lending incident categories
OWASP SC03: oracle manipulation
OWASP SCSVS-GOV: economic safety
entries.what_if: A zUSD vault/support/oracle recovery path chooses the wrong source of truth or selector state.

source_families: Principles of Chaos Engineering: steady-state disruption and controlled perturbation
CAPEC: compound adversarial operation sequences
OWASP SCSVS: cross-control regression pressure
entries.what_if: A compound perturbation disrupts steady state and the system neither rejects nor presents a valid recovery certificate.

source_families: CAPEC: commitment manipulation and data integrity patterns
OWASP SCSVS-CRYPTO: hash/signature binding
De.Fi Rekt: marketplace, DAO, and incentive incident seeds
entries.what_if: A commitment, reveal, bounty catalog, or candidate-index feedback path admits a substituted or omitted candidate.

source_families: CAPEC: multi-stage and chained attack patterns
OWASP SCSVS-ARCH: architecture, design, and threat modeling
Chaos: interaction faults between otherwise healthy subsystems
entries.what_if: Two locally valid proof, runtime, or policy surfaces compose into a globally invalid state.

source_families: De.Fi Rekt: derivatives, lending, liquidation, and oracle incident seeds
OWASP SC03/SC07: oracle and arithmetic failure classes
OWASP SCSVS-GOV: economic safety
entries.what_if: Perps settlement, funding, liquidation, legacy refs, or submission guards disagree at an oracle or arithmetic boundary.
